note: Voice lines for the booth attendant. Korean and Bahasa Malaysia are separate performances, not translations of one recording — see README. Bracketed tags are eleven_v3 audio tags and are not spoken.
character: The booth attendant is the cafe's dachshund mascot grown into a voice: short-legged, over-eager, absolutely certain this photo is going to be the good one. Warm, quick, never sarcastic. She compliments the guest and never the booth. Korean is 해요체 — polite but not stiff. Malay is casual spoken Malaysian, the register a cafe staffer actually uses, not textbook Bahasa Baku.
rules: Under 2.5 seconds. Guests are posing, not listening.
Never explain the interface — the screen already says it. Voice carries warmth, the screen carries instruction.
Never apologise. A failed upload gets silence, not a voice line.
Every line must survive its 200th play in a small room.
A line written for a gap must be shorter than the gap. The between-shot window is 700 ms of clear air before the next countdown pip, which is room for one word, not a sentence.

wake.hook: show('frame') from attract — the first thing a guest ever hears. Doubles as the frame screen's line; there is no second line on that screen.
wake.ko: [warmly] 어서 오세요! 오늘 잘 나올 것 같은데요?
wake.ko_gloss: Welcome! I have a feeling these are going to come out well.
wake.ms_gloss: Welcome! I reckon this'll turn out lovely.

frame.hook: NOT USED — wake already lands on this screen, and the screen title already says to pick a colour. Two lines back to back on one screen is over-talking.

ready.hook: show('shoot'), before the guest presses the shutter button — the whole screen is idle until they do, so this line has all the air it needs.

countdown.hook: NOT USED — the countdown is beeps (count.mp3 / count_go.mp3). Kept only as the reference line for auditioning a new voice, since three counted numbers expose a voice's rhythm and accent faster than any other phrase.

between.hook: the gap after shots 1 and 3. One word: the next pip is 700 ms behind the shutter, so anything longer talks over the count.

between_alt.hook: the gap after shot 2 — alternates with between so four shots do not repeat one word. 'Ha, macam tu!' and '그거예요!' were the first draft and read 1.4 s each, half a second over the gap.

last.hook: NOT USED — it belongs in the gap before the fourth shot, but that gap already carries a between line and the slot counter already shows 3/4. Kept because it is the right line if the inter-shot gap is ever widened.
last.ko_gloss: Last one. Make it the prettiest!
last.ms_gloss: The last one. Give me your best!

select.hook: show('select'), 700 ms after the fourth shutter
select.ko: 제일 잘 나온 걸로 골라 주세요.
select.ko_gloss: Choose the one that came out best.

filter.ko_gloss: Shall we change the mood a bit?
filter.ms_gloss: Want to change the mood a little?

printing.hook: NOT USED — it would sit on top of the 3.16 s eject motor, and the motor already says 'printing' better than words do. The screen carries the instruction; done is the payoff.
printing.ko_gloss: It's printing. Just a moment please.
printing.ms_gloss: It's printing. Wait a moment, yeah.

done.hook: the eject lands, 3.2 s into startPrint() — the only line carrying real instruction, so nothing is allowed to cut it off
done.ko_gloss: Your photo's out! Hold it by the edges.
done.ms: [warmly] Dah siap! Pegang tepi gambar ya.
done.ms_gloss: It's ready! Hold it by the edges, yeah.

qr.hook: setQrState('ready'), which can resolve while done is still speaking — queued behind it rather than interrupting. Skipped entirely when the upload failed.
qr.ko: 큐알 찍으면 파일도 가져가실 수 있어요.
qr.ko_gloss: Scan the QR and you can take the file too.
qr.ms: Imbas QR untuk simpan gambar digital.
qr.ms_gloss: Scan the QR to keep the digital copy.
